groups.problem: Backup-code verification uses non-constant-time plaintext comparisons and early-exit array traversal.
groups.rationale: Both suggestions report the same verification mistake repeated in the disable endpoint and login handler. Each location needs to adopt constant-time verification.

groups.problem: Non-atomic backup-code consumption allows concurrent requests to reuse or restore consumed codes.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same unconditional update of a previously read backup-code list. Duplicate authentication and lost removals are consequences of the same race, resolved by atomic consumption.
